scheme_name: Internship Scheme By The Unique Identification Authority Of India (UIDAI)
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Applicant must be a bonafide student of a recognized university/institution in India or abroad.
For technical B.Tech/B.E students, must be in the 3rd or 4th year with at least 60% marks in prior semesters.
For graduate students, must have completed/appeared in the 1st year/2nd semester of a postgraduate programme or be pursuing research/PhD with at least 60% marks in graduation.

Students who have completed graduation/post‑graduation and are awaiting admission or job must have cumulative ≥60% marks and the gap between result declaration and internship start must not exceed six months.
Internship duration must be at least six weeks and not exceed 12 months.
Interns who do not complete the required period will not receive a certificate.
For fellowship, the student must be registered for a PhD at an Indian institution.
Candidates applying for a 1‑year internship must apply within six months of completing the final exam.
benefits_summary: Stipend ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹50,000 per month depending on qualification and work location, plus optional lodging facilities on a payment basis.
documents_required: Duly filled and signed application form in the prescribed format
